approved.sha2: SHA-256 content/protocol identities; SHA-224 only for established external identity formats
approved.blake3: Existing IcyDB fingerprints and deterministic qualification data; new purposes require review
approved.xxhash-rust: Existing IcyDB XXH3 non-security value hashing; not integrity or authentication
approved.hmac: Existing HMAC-SHA-256 keyed diagnostics; not an unkeyed content hash
approved.crc32fast: Established external identity/checksum formats; not integrity or authentication

digest.purpose: Optional Digest trait forwarding for external BLS hash-to-curve into SHA-2 0.11; no new hash algorithm
